brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu branded the United Kingdom the "Islamic Republic of Britain" while deploying anti-Muslim rhetoric, Eye on Palestine reported. The comments represent an intensification of his criticism of British policy and the country's Muslim communities.

The remarks emerged as the UK has criminalized support for Palestine and arrested more than 2,700 protesters demonstrating against Israeli military operations. British authorities have also been found complicit in the Gaza genocide, according to the report. Netanyahu's statement marks a sharp escalation in his public criticism of Britain's approach to both Palestine advocacy and its treatment of Muslim citizens.
